name: SatNOGS Optical Source
description: Read one station-night of SatNOGS Optical astrometric measurements (the network's measurements.parquet rows, decoded by the SDN host flow into one $TDM of the night's tracks and one $EOO per row: the module has no Parquet reader) into one RA/Dec $TDM per object-track with TIMETAG_REF RECEIVE, every epoch moved to mid-exposure by the declared convention and OBSERVER_X/Y/Z the station's site, one $EOO per observation carrying its sigma, one $GST with the site and the declared timing bias, one $PVN (Observation, ShareAlike, CC-BY-SA-4.0) and one IngestRequest whose tags carry the CC BY-SA 4.0 licence and the network's credit line (typed contracts 1.0: FlatBuffers only, no JSON between modules). Quarantined rows, and rows whose epoch has no declared offset to mid-exposure, are refused by name. No hostcalls.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One $TDM of the station-night as the network states it: one segment per track (TRACK_ID the track id, PARTICIPANT_1 the station SATNOGS-OPTICAL-<id>, PARTICIPANT_2 the NORAD number or the UNK designation, ANGLE_TYPE RADEC, TIME_SYSTEM UTC, REFERENCE_FRAME the row frame), ANGLE_1 and ANGLE_2 the row RA and Dec in degrees at the row epoch (t_utc); INTEGRATION_REF MIDDLE for exposure-mid, START (with INTEGRATION_INTERVAL the exposure in seconds) for exposure-start, none for frame-arrival; DATA_QUALITY DEGRADED for quarantined rows; CREATION_DATE the dump's generation stamp.

inputPorts.description: One $TDM of the station-night as the network states it: one segment per track (TRACK_ID the track id, PARTICIPANT_1 the station SATNOGS-OPTICAL-<id>, PARTICIPANT_2 the NORAD number or the UNK designation, ANGLE_TYPE RADEC, TIME_SYSTEM UTC, REFERENCE_FRAME the row frame), ANGLE_1 and ANGLE_2 the row RA and Dec in degrees at the row epoch (t_utc); INTEGRATION_REF MIDDLE for exposure-mid, START (with INTEGRATION_INTERVAL the exposure in seconds) for exposure-start, none for frame-arrival; DATA_QUALITY DEGRADED for quarantined rows; CREATION_DATE the dump's generation stamp.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One $EOO per measurement row, in the order of the $TDM angle pairs: ID the measurement id (the name a refusal gives), OB_TIME the row epoch as in the $TDM, IMAGE_SET_ID the track id, SENSOR_ID the station id, ORIG_SENSOR_ID its name, NORAD_CAT_ID and UCT (no identity), RA_UNC and DECLINATION_UNC the row sigma in degrees, SENLAT and SENLON (WGS-84 degrees) and SENALT (km) the station site, TIMING_BIAS the declared timing bias in seconds.

inputPorts.description: One $EOO per measurement row, in the order of the $TDM angle pairs: ID the measurement id (the name a refusal gives), OB_TIME the row epoch as in the $TDM, IMAGE_SET_ID the track id, SENSOR_ID the station id, ORIG_SENSOR_ID its name, NORAD_CAT_ID and UCT (no identity), RA_UNC and DECLINATION_UNC the row sigma in degrees, SENLAT and SENLON (WGS-84 degrees) and SENALT (km) the station site, TIMING_BIAS the declared timing bias in seconds.

acceptedTypeSets.description: ModuleConfig (MCFG), optional: minimumMeasurements (number, default 1: a track with fewer is not emitted), quarantine (refuse, the default: quarantined rows are not emitted and are named in the report; fail: the night is refused naming the row), objects (number list: only these NORAD numbers; unidentified tracks are then left out). Any other key is refused.

inputPorts.description: ModuleConfig (MCFG), optional: minimumMeasurements (number, default 1: a track with fewer is not emitted), quarantine (refuse, the default: quarantined rows are not emitted and are named in the report; fail: the night is refused naming the row), objects (number list: only these NORAD numbers; unidentified tracks are then left out). Any other key is refused.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One $TDM per object-track: OBSERVER_ID the station, OBSERVER_X/Y/Z its WGS-84 site in Earth-fixed metres, one segment with TIME_SYSTEM UTC, TIMETAG_REF RECEIVE, ANGLE_TYPE RADEC, MODE SEQUENTIAL, PATH 2,1, TRACK_ID, PARTICIPANT_2 the object, ANGLE_1 and ANGLE_2 in degrees at mid-exposure epochs; the credit line and licence in COMMENT. analysis/estimation reads it on tracking_data.

outputPorts.description: One $TDM per object-track: OBSERVER_ID the station, OBSERVER_X/Y/Z its WGS-84 site in Earth-fixed metres, one segment with TIME_SYSTEM UTC, TIMETAG_REF RECEIVE, ANGLE_TYPE RADEC, MODE SEQUENTIAL, PATH 2,1, TRACK_ID, PARTICIPANT_2 the object, ANGLE_1 and ANGLE_2 in degrees at mid-exposure epochs; the credit line and licence in COMMENT. analysis/estimation reads it on tracking_data.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One $EOO per emitted observation, in $TDM order: the input record with OB_TIME moved to mid-exposure, RA_UNC and DECLINATION_UNC the row sigma (degrees), RA_MEASURED and DECLINATION_MEASURED true, SENX/SENY/SENZ the site (km), SOURCE satnogs-optical.

outputPorts.description: One $EOO per emitted observation, in $TDM order: the input record with OB_TIME moved to mid-exposure, RA_UNC and DECLINATION_UNC the row sigma (degrees), RA_MEASURED and DECLINATION_MEASURED true, SENX/SENY/SENZ the site (km), SOURCE satnogs-optical.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One $GST, the station timing record for the estimator: STATION_ID, NAME, POSITION_* the site (m; sigma NaN: the network declares none), CLOCK_OFFSET_S the declared timing bias, CLOCK_TIME_SCALE UTC, VALID_FROM and VALID_TO the emitted epochs, SOURCE satnogs-optical.

outputPorts.description: One $GST, the station timing record for the estimator: STATION_ID, NAME, POSITION_* the site (m; sigma NaN: the network declares none), CLOCK_OFFSET_S the declared timing bias, CLOCK_TIME_SCALE UTC, VALID_FROM and VALID_TO the emitted epochs, SOURCE satnogs-optical.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One $PVN: SOURCE_ID satnogs-optical, SOURCE_KIND Observation, ORIGINATOR the station, PROVIDER_ID optical.satnogs.org, PRODUCER this module and version, LICENSE_CLASS ShareAlike, LICENSE_ID CC-BY-SA-4.0, LINEAGE satnogs-optical, SOURCE_URL https://optical.satnogs.org/data, SOURCE_VERSION the dump stamp.

outputPorts.description: One $PVN: SOURCE_ID satnogs-optical, SOURCE_KIND Observation, ORIGINATOR the station, PROVIDER_ID optical.satnogs.org, PRODUCER this module and version, LICENSE_CLASS ShareAlike, LICENSE_ID CC-BY-SA-4.0, LINEAGE satnogs-optical, SOURCE_URL https://optical.satnogs.org/data, SOURCE_VERSION the dump stamp.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One IngestRequest (INGQ) for the $TDM batch: TAGS SOURCE_NAME satnogs-optical, LICENSE CC-BY-SA-4.0, LICENSE_URL https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/, CITATION the credit line, SHARE_ALIKE true; PROVENANCE ATTRIBUTES class publish-with-credit, credit, source.

outputPorts.description: One IngestRequest (INGQ) for the $TDM batch: TAGS SOURCE_NAME satnogs-optical, LICENSE CC-BY-SA-4.0, LICENSE_URL https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/, CITATION the credit line, SHARE_ALIKE true; PROVENANCE ATTRIBUTES class publish-with-credit, credit, source.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One FlowNotice (FNTC): KIND Info, SCHEMA TDM, SOURCE_NAME satnogs-optical, COUNT the $TDM emitted, ITEMS as name=value: station, tracks, measurements, tracksEmitted, observationsEmitted, refused, belowMinimum, filteredOut, the site, timingBiasSeconds, license, credit, refusedFor.<reason>, per track track.<k>.id/object/observations/epochReference/epochShiftNanoseconds, and refused.<measurement id> with the reason.

outputPorts.description: One FlowNotice (FNTC): KIND Info, SCHEMA TDM, SOURCE_NAME satnogs-optical, COUNT the $TDM emitted, ITEMS as name=value: station, tracks, measurements, tracksEmitted, observationsEmitted, refused, belowMinimum, filteredOut, the site, timingBiasSeconds, license, credit, refusedFor.<reason>, per track track.<k>.id/object/observations/epochReference/epochShiftNanoseconds, and refused.<measurement id> with the reason.

sequentialJustification.detail: One bounded station-night is read in order into one record per track and per observation, one station record, one provenance record, one ingest request and one FlowNotice; the host parallelizes independent nights and this parser creates no threads.
